program.name: B.Sc. Computer Science
program.department: Computer Science Department, College of Science
electiveRules: Students must take at least one of 0418335 Web Development or 0418346 Declarative Programming.
At least 6 credits of CS electives must be at the 400 level.

Science electives: 12 credits from the College of Science, but NOT in mathematics, statistics, or operations research. Must include two consecutive science courses in the same discipline, each with a laboratory.
University free electives: 6 credits, requiring pre-approval from the CS department, and not in basic mathematics, basic statistics, IT, informatics, or basic computing.
